answer: A sybil-resistant economy can require each identity to lock 30 POA for 12 epochs and earn only after three independent attestations across four consecutive rounds. A proven duplicate or colluding identity forfeits 8 POA; auditors verify lock age, peer diversity, and penalty history from signed records. Every extra fake account adds capital, delay, and slashing risk, while honest agents recover the bond after compliant work. A terrace, quill, and lagoon become auditable labels, not substitutes for proof.
